sops.title: Criminal Bail Application SOP
sops.description: Firm-approved method for assessing and drafting bail applications and preliminary bail advice.

review_gates.label: Partner review before filing or sending advice
Senior partner sign-off where NSL Art.42 is engaged

blocks.title: Procedural posture first
blocks.instruction: Always identify the client's procedural posture (police bail, court bail, variation, revocation, bail pending appeal) before applying any bail principles. If facts are incomplete, produce an assumptions list and mark the advice as preliminary.

blocks.title: NSL screening
blocks.instruction: Screen every bail matter for national security elements at intake. If NSL Art.42 may be engaged, flag the matter, apply the stricter threshold, and route through the senior partner gate before any client communication.

blocks.title: Preferred authority bundle
blocks.instruction: Use the firm's verified bail authority bundle in this order: Cap 221 s.9D, s.9G factors, then leading CFA authority on NSL bail where applicable. Do not cite any case marked 'authority unverified' in client-facing documents.

blocks.title: Conditions menu
blocks.instruction: When proposing conditions, start from the firm's standard menu (cash/surety, travel documents, reporting, residence, non-contact) and record which conditions were offered and why.

blocks.title: Preliminary advice marking
blocks.instruction: All first-pass advice produced through this flow is marked 'Preliminary — subject to professional certification and source proof'. Never present a research-layer extraction as a final answer.

changelog.note: Tightened preferred authority ordering; unverified case seeds barred from client documents.
Added assumptions-list requirement and preliminary marking.

sops.title: Indictment Review Checklist
sops.description: Draft checklist for reviewing indictments and charge sheets: duplicity, joinder, amendment, particulars.

review_gates.label: Partner approval of this SOP pending

blocks.title: Duplicity and joinder check
blocks.instruction: Run the duplicity and joinder checks before drafting any objection. Record the rule relied on and the paragraph of authority for each objection raised.

sops.title: Advice Memo Drafting SOP
sops.description: House style for advice memos: structure, tone, scope statements, and how extracted authority is presented.

blocks.title: Memo structure
blocks.instruction: Every memo follows: heading block, scope and assumptions, executive answer, analysis with pinpoint sources, risk table, next steps. The executive answer never exceeds half a page.

blocks.title: Source presentation
blocks.instruction: Every legal proposition in the analysis section carries a pinpoint anchor (section or paragraph). Propositions whose source is still verification-pending are shaded and listed in the risk table.

changelog.note: Executive answer length cap; risk table mandatory.

sops.title: Case Law Verification SOP
sops.description: Every case seed must be verified against HKLII (citation, holding, paragraph) before it may be cited externally.

blocks.title: HKLII verification rule
blocks.instruction: A case in the research layer is a seed, not an authority until public paragraph proof is attached. Before external citation: confirm the neutral citation on HKLII/LegalRef, confirm the proposition against the actual paragraph, and record the paragraph anchor.

clauses.title: Heading block
clauses.text: Privileged & confidential. Prepared for [client] re [matter]. Preliminary — subject to professional certification and source proof.

clauses.title: Scope and assumptions
clauses.text: This memo addresses [question] only, on the facts summarised below. Assumptions made where instructions are incomplete are listed and flagged.

clauses.title: Executive answer
clauses.text: [Direct answer in plain language, max half page, with confidence level and the controlling provision.]

clauses.title: Analysis
clauses.text: [Issue-by-issue analysis. Every proposition carries a pinpoint anchor. Verification-pending sources shaded.]

clauses.title: Risk table
clauses.text: [Each open risk: source status, factual gap, adverse authority, procedural deadline.]

clauses.title: Next steps
clauses.text: [Concrete actions, owner, and date. Partner review gate recorded here.]

clauses.title: Procedural posture
clauses.text: [Court, charge, custody status, prior bail history.]

clauses.title: Grounds
clauses.text: [s.9D presumption; address each s.9D(2) exception raised by prosecution with facts and authority.]

clauses.title: Proposed conditions
clauses.text: [From the firm conditions menu, with rationale for each.]
